citation: Koch et al. (2004), Mass Segregation in the Globular Cluster Palomar 5 and its Tidal Tails, section 5
limitations: Approximate power-law fits to a curved MF; reported formal errors do not include all modelling systematics.
Data cover approximately 0.58-0.86 Msun; power-law fits use masses below 0.82 Msun.
A present-day tail segment is not automatically representative of all escape times and stream locations.
North and south are alternative spatial constraints, not independent measurements of a universal slope to multiply together.
No constraint on unseen lower-mass stars, remnants, or the living-star/dynamical mass conversion.
